AZ.name: Arizona
AZ.notes: Direct PDF link. Session format in URL is like '57leg/2R'. bill_type is HB/SB. bill_number is digits only.

FL.name: Florida
FL.notes: PDF available via BillText tab. session is 4-digit year. bill_number is digits only (from bill identifier, not bill_type). e1 = first engrossed. May need e2, e3 for amended versions.

HI.name: Hawaii
HI.pdf_selector_hint: Look for the small PDF icon/logo next to the hyperlinked bill number. That links directly to the bill text PDF.
HI.notes: bill_type is SB/HB. bill_number is digits only. session is 4-digit year.

IA.name: Iowa
IA.notes: Direct PDF link. ga=91 is the 91st General Assembly (2025-2026). bill_type is HF/SF/HJR/SJR. bill_number is digits only.

IN.name: Indiana
IN.pdf_selector_hint: Look for 'Latest Version' section which has a PDF logo/link to the bill text PDF.
IN.notes: chamber is 'senate' or 'house'. bill_number is digits only. session is 4-digit year.

ME.name: Maine
ME.pdf_selector_hint: Look in the 'Documents' section. Has links to original bill and amendments. The most recent amendment contains the full updated bill text. Prefer the latest amendment over the original if amendments exist.
ME.notes: Maine uses paper IDs (like HP1451) not bill numbers. legislature=132 is the 132nd session. Documents section has PDF links.

MS.name: Mississippi
MS.pdf_selector_hint: This XML page contains links to PDF versions of the bill. Look for the bill text PDF link.
MS.notes: MS uses an XML-based bill status system. session is 4-digit year. bill_type is HB/SB. bill_number is digits only.

NE.name: Nebraska
NE.pdf_selector_hint: Look for PDF link on the bill page. DocumentID is a unique number per bill.
NE.notes: Nebraska uses DocumentID rather than bill number in URLs. PDF link should be on the page.

NY.name: New York
NY.pdf_selector_hint: NY Assembly site requires checking a 'Text' checkbox to display bill text. The text appears inline on the page, not as a PDF. Use WebFetch to extract the full page content after the text is displayed, or save the page content as the bill text.
NY.notes: NY is tricky — bill text requires interaction (checkbox). May need to capture HTML text content rather than PDF. term=2025 for 2025-2026 session. bill_type is A/S for Assembly/Senate.

OK.name: Oklahoma
OK.notes: PDF URL uses '2025-26 INT' for introduced versions. Session=2600 for 2025-2026 session. bill_type is SB/HB.

TN.name: Tennessee
TN.notes: Direct PDF link. ga=114 is the 114th General Assembly. bill_type is SB/HB. bill_number is digits only.

UT.name: Utah
UT.notes: bill_number_padded is zero-padded to 4 digits (e.g., 286 -> 0286). session is 4-digit year. S01 suffix for substitute 1. bill_type is HB/SB.

WA.name: Washington
WA.pdf_selector_hint: Look for 'Available Documents' section. Find the latest version PDF link. Prefer 'Substitute' or 'Engrossed' versions over 'Original' if available.
WA.notes: Multiple versions listed under Available Documents. Bill number is digits only. Year is session start year (2025 for 2025-26 session).

WV.name: West Virginia
WV.notes: Direct PDF link. session is 4-digit year. bill_type_lower is hb/sb. bill_number is digits only. 'intr' suffix for introduced version. sessiontype=RS for regular session.

AL.name: Alabama
AL.notes: Direct PDF link. session is 4-digit year. bill_type is HB/SB. RS = Regular Session. -int suffix for introduced version.

CA.name: California
CA.pdf_selector_hint: Look for PDF download link on the bill page. session_id is like '202520260' for 2025-2026 session. bill_type is AB/SB.
CA.notes: CA leginfo has bill text as HTML and also a PDF option. session_id format: start year + end year + '0'.

IL.name: Illinois
IL.pdf_selector_hint: Go to the 'Full Text' tab, then click the 'PDF' button/logo to get the bill text PDF.
IL.notes: GAID=18 and SessionID=114 for 2025-2026 session. bill_type is HB/SB. bill_number is digits only.

KS.name: Kansas
KS.pdf_selector_hint: Under 'Bill Versions' in the 'Documents' column, find PDF logo links. Multiple versions may exist — choose the most recent one.
KS.notes: bill_type_lower is sb/hb. bill_number is digits only. b2025_26 is the biennium.

KY.name: Kentucky
KY.pdf_selector_hint: Under the 'Bill Documents' tab, look for the hyperlink labeled 'Current' which leads to the current bill version PDF.
KY.notes: 26rs = 2026 Regular Session. bill_type_lower is hb/sb. bill_number is digits only.

LA.name: Louisiana
LA.pdf_selector_hint: Go to the 'Text' tab and find the PDF link there.
LA.notes: Louisiana uses doc_id (unique number) in URLs, not bill numbers directly. The FPF resolved URL should provide this.

MD.name: Maryland
MD.pdf_selector_hint: Click the hyperlinked bill number on the page to get the PDF version of the bill text.
MD.notes: bill_type_lower is hb/sb. bill_number_padded is zero-padded to 4 digits. session is 4-digit year. RS = Regular Session.

NJ.name: New Jersey
NJ.pdf_selector_hint: Scroll down to find multiple versions. Look for 'pdf format' links. The most recent version is at the bottom of the list.
NJ.notes: session is 4-digit year. bill_type is A/S for Assembly/Senate. bill_number is digits only.

NM.name: New Mexico
NM.pdf_selector_hint: Under the 'Text' section, find hyperlinks to PDF versions of the bill.
NM.notes: chamber is H or S. year=26 for 2026. bill_number is digits only.

OR.name: Oregon
OR.pdf_selector_hint: Find the hyperlinked bill number on the overview page — it links directly to the bill text PDF.
OR.notes: 2026R1 is the 2026 Regular Session. bill_type is SB/HB. bill_number is digits only.

RI.name: Rhode Island
RI.notes: Direct PDF link. chamber_folder is 'SenateText26' or 'HouseText26'. bill_type_ri is S or H (single letter). bill_number is digits only. 26 = 2026.

SD.name: South Dakota
SD.pdf_selector_hint: Scroll down to 'Bill Text Versions' section and find the hyperlinked 'pdf format' text.
SD.notes: SD uses doc_id (unique number) in URLs. The FPF resolved URL should provide this.

VA.name: Virginia
VA.pdf_selector_hint: In the 'History' section, find the most recent action that has document links. Under those links (vote, introduced, PDF), click 'PDF' for the correct version.
VA.notes: 20261 = 2026 session 1. bill_type is HB/SB. bill_number is digits only.

VT.name: Vermont
VT.pdf_selector_hint: Scroll down to 'Bill/Resolution Text' section. Multiple columns show different stages. Find the most recent one and click the 'Official' or 'Introduced' hyperlink for the PDF.
VT.notes: session is 4-digit year. bill_type_vt is H or S (single letter). bill_number is digits only. Dot separator between type and number.

WI.name: Wisconsin
WI.pdf_selector_hint: Under the 'Links' section, find the hyperlinked 'Bill Text' which leads to the PDF.
WI.notes: chamber_lower is 'sen' or 'asm'. bill_type_lower is sb/ab. bill_number is digits only. 2025 is the session start year.

US.name: Federal
US.notes: Federal bills on congress.gov. chamber_slug is 'senate-bill' or 'house-bill'. bill_type_lower is 's' or 'hr'. 'is' suffix = introduced in senate, 'ih' = introduced in house.
